**Plan, not yet applied.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js) gives the data. `main()` in [cli.js:8](src/cli.js:8) just picks a printer.

1. Parse `--json` out of `argv` alongside the `report` check.
2. If set, `process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(buildRows(), null, 2) + '\n')`.
3. Else keep the existing `toTable` path.

No changes to `report.js` or `format.js` needed. Want me to make the edit?
